text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a rolling NIC firmware update + graceful kernel reboot in us-east1 next Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Targeting racks r5-r8 (gpu-pool-dedicated-7/8). Expect 6–10 minute drain per node + warmup.

maria: what's the expected capacity impact? any customer-facing windows? :thinking_face:

alex: We estimate ~12% usable GPU capacity reduced during the window due to cohorting. No planned customer-visible downtime — routing will fallback to other regions for latency-tolerant jobs. But Dedicated customers with pinned capacity may see transient queueing.

sam: Can we stagger by AZ instead of rack to reduce cross-region spill? us-east1-a has most running priority jobs.

alex: Good point. Proposal: do AZ B then A then C. Cohort size ~8 nodes per batch, 3 batches per AZ. Total ~72 nodes. Each batch drain->reboot->warmup ~15m. So full window ~3.5h including buffers.

kevin: Any networking constraints? NIC firmware changes previously caused path flaps on the top-of-rack switches when vmx features were toggled.

ops-dev: We've tested on staging racks (nvlink offload) — saw brief ARP storms, fixed by adding 30s sleep between bringing interfaces up. We'll include that in the runbook.

maria: Who's owning canary + rollback criteria?

alex: Canary = first batch in us-east1-b (low traffic). Metrics to watch: packet drops >0.1%, p95 pod attach latency >150ms, sustained GPU utilization dip >10% for >5m. If any trigger, abort and initiate rollback (NIC firmware revert script).

lia: Can you paste the cordon/drain commands? I'll add to oncall playbook.

alex: Sure:
```
kubectl cordon node-r5-12
kubectl drain node-r5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```
Then run `fw_update --apply --nic node-r5-12` and reboot.

sam: Reminder: warmup step MUST include KV cache pre-population for model serving. We'll run `cache-warm --prefix-check 90%` as part of post-reboot checks.

oncall-bot: Incident scheduled: maintenance/us-east1-nic-fw @ 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z. Pager escalation unchanged. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Cost question — if routing spills to other regions, egress and cross-region GPU utilization increases. Estimate ~$2.5k additional spend for the window. Ops ok with that?

maria: Budget approved for one-off maintenance; log the cost to Q2 infra ops. Ops, please tag usage with `maintenance:us-east1-fw`.

ops-dev: Runbook notes added. We'll throttle batches if queueing >20% for >10m. Also adding a 10-minute cooloff between AZs this time.

lia: I'll send a short notice to #customer-success and to Dedicated customers with pinned capacity. Draft: "Planned NIC firmware update in us-east1 Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. No expected customer downtime; brief queueing possible for pinned capacity. Contact support if you see issues." Thoughts?

alex: LGTM. @maria can you sign off on canary thresholds? @kevin please double-check cost tag automation.

maria: Signed-off. I'll monitor metrics during the window.

kevin: Cost tag automation validated.

lia: Notifying teams now. :email:

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll meet 01:30 UTC in #eng-infra for preflight. Quieter channel for coordination will be this thread.
